description: List the layers of a Washington, DC ArcGIS service (for discovery). Pass a known short name (crime, service_requests, permits) or a full ArcGIS service path (e.g. "FEEDS/MPD/MapServer"). Omit `service` to list the known DC services. Returns layer id + name to use with dc_query.

service.description: Short name (crime|service_requests|permits) or full ArcGIS service path. Omit to list known services.

name: dc_layers
title: Dc Layers
